Name: Mobile Button B Polling Patch
Author: Ekysoh
Description: Allows you to hold the virtual joypad B button down like controller. No longer need to tap to place! This mod is only for mobile devices. It doesn't do anything on PC.

Downloads.Description: - Added initial delay to distinguish taps from holds. This prevents menus from double opening.

Manifest.Name: MobileButtonBPolling
Manifest.Description: Allows the B button on mobile to be held down for repeated actions, similar to keyboard/mouse controls.
Manifest.Author: Ekyso
